lines.text: Joash was seven years old when he became king, and he did what was right all the days of Jehoiada.
Joash set his heart on repairing the house of the LORD, but the Levites did not make haste.
At the king's command a chest was made and placed outside, at the altar of the house of the LORD.
The king and Jehoiada gave the money to supervisors, who hired stonecutters and carpenters to restore the house of the LORD.
Jehoiada died at the age of 175 and was buried with the kings in the City of David.
